content_sections.heading: GRSE Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited has issued Employment Notification No. 2026/05 (J&OP) for the recruitment of 58 Journeyman and Driver (Vehicle) posts. Official Recruitment Notices: GRSE Careers - Current Job Openings

content_sections.heading: GRSE Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the qualifications prescribed for their selected post as on 1 October 2026 . Journeyman posts require 10th Pass and relevant National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) or National Trade Certificate (NTC) qualifications. Driver (Vehicle) posts require a valid Commercial LMV Driving Licence and six years of relevant driving experience. Driver applicants must have a clean driving record without major accidents, police complaints related to accidents, serious traffic violations, reckless driving or driving under the influence of alcohol during the preceding six years. The notification excludes candidates holding specified higher professional qualifications, including Engineering/Technology degrees, MBA, CA, CMA, CS, LL.B., MCA, Ph.D. or equivalent higher professional qualifications. Candidates must disclose all educational qualifications. Concealing a qualification may lead to cancellation of selection even after appointment.

content_sections.heading: GRSE Journeyman Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Journeymen will undergo two years of training on a fixed monthly stipend. PF contributions and applicable statutory deductions will be made according to the company's rules. Medical and hospitalization benefits are subject to the notified conditions. After successful completion of the two-year training, Journeymen may be considered for absorption into the permanent Semi-Skilled (SSK) grade, subject to performance, vacancies, medical fitness, disciplinary clearance and organizational requirements. Important: Completion of Journeyman training does not automatically guarantee permanent absorption. The notified conditions must be fulfilled.

content_sections.text: The Driver (Vehicle) post carries a pay scale of Rs. 20,110 - 3% - Rs. 70,390 in Skilled Grade-III, along with applicable benefits. The pay scale is subject to revision under the company's rules and does not represent a fixed in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: GRSE Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The recruitment involves a written examination followed by a Practical Trade Test, document verification and other applicable assessments. Application scrutiny and shortlisting, if required. Written Examination. Document Verification. Practical Trade Test. Physical Efficiency Test for Crane Operator, Driver Material Handling and Rigger posts. Medical Examination and applicable verification procedures. Screening and shortlisting based on the prescribed eligibility and relevant experience. Written Examination. Document Verification. Practical Driving / Trade Test. Pre-Employment Medical Examination and other required checks. GRSE will shortlist candidates for the Practical Trade Test in a ratio of approximately 1:5 based on written examination merit, subject to the notified tie rules.

content_sections.heading: GRSE Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: The written examination for both recruitment categories is an OMR-based test consisting of 100 objective questions for 100 marks , with a duration of two hours. The qualifying marks differ for Journeyman and Driver (Vehicle). The Practical Trade Test carries 50 marks and is qualifying in nature. Candidates must obtain at least 50%, or the applicable relaxed qualifying percentage, to be considered for final merit. The final merit list will be prepared using written examination marks among candidates who qualify in the required Practical Trade Test and other applicable selection stages.

content_sections.heading: GRSE Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit online applications from 30 October 2026 at 2:00 PM until 28 November 2026 at 11:59 PM . Apply Online: GRSE Recruitment 2026 Official Application Portal Official Careers Page: GRSE Careers Candidates must select Employment Notification No. 2026/05 (J&OP) when the relevant application facility is available. Applications through offline, postal, email or other modes are not accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for GRSE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload the documents supporting their eligibility and produce original certificates during document verification. 10th Pass certificate and marksheet. Age or date-of-birth proof. Relevant NAC/NTC trade certificate for Journeyman applicants. Commercial LMV Driving Licence for Driver (Vehicle) applicants. Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence, where applicable. Experience certificates or accepted employment records, where required. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificates, where applicable. PwBD certificate, if applicable. Ex-Serviceman or Ex-Agniveer documents, where applicable. No Objection Certificate for eligible serving employees, where required. Other documents specified by the online application portal. Experience Certificate Rule: Driver applicants must provide documentary evidence of their qualifying six years of driving experience. GRSE may require appointment letters, recent pay slips, relieving details and additional employer confirmation during verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited (GRSE), a premier defence shipbuilding company located in Kolkata, West Bengal, for filling up various technical and driving positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under GRSE Advt No 2026/05 (J&OP)?
faq.answer: A total of 58 vacancies have been announced under this notification, distributed across multiple trades of Journeyman and Driver (Vehicle) positions for eligible candidates meeting the trade criteria.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting and last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online registration process starts on 30 October 2026 and candidates can submit their online applications until 28 November 2026 through the official GRSE application portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for Journeyman posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Journeyman positions must have passed Matriculation (10th standard) along with a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) or National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the respective relevant trades.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Journeyman and Driver posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 26 years for Journeyman posts and 32 years for Driver (Vehicle) posts as on 01.10.2026, with applicable age relaxations provided for reserved categories like SC, ST, and OBC.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 472/- online, whereas SC, ST, PwBD, and internal candidates are fully exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or stipend structure for Journeymen during training?
faq.answer: Journeymen will undergo a 2-year training period on a fixed stipendiary basis, receiving Rs. 24,000/- per month during the first year and Rs. 26,000/- per month during the second year.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GRSE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test, a Physical Efficiency Test for specific operator and handling roles, Document Verification, and a Practical or Trade Test to evaluate operational skills.

faq.question: Q9. Are candidates with higher professional qualifications eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as Graduate or Post Graduate Degrees in Engineering, Technology, Pharmacy, MBA, CA, CMA, CS, LL.B, MCA, or Ph.D are explicitly not eligible.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply exclusively through online mode by visiting the career section of the official GRSE website at www.grse.in or via the designated online application portal before the closing date.
